sources.title: Town of Lake Cowichan 2024 SOFI: employee-remuneration
sources.scopeDescription: Seven internally consistent named staff rows; Jessica May is withheld;2024 council remains solely in its earlier accepted source.
sources.expensesNote: Literal Expense column, defined as Travel, Conferences and Other. Expense-inclusive Totals remain evidence and are never remuneration.
sources.publicWarning: Partial employee schedule: seven of eight named employees are included. Jessica May is withheld because published Financial Compensation $92,354.93 plus Expenses $5,429.75 equals $97,784.68, while the row's expense-inclusive Total is $92,784.68, a $5,000.00 conflict. No amount is corrected or selected to force agreement. All other employees aggregate Total is $0.09 below its pay-plus-expense components. Original full-cohort remuneration and expense controls reconcile, but do not resolve the row conflict.
notes: The original staff schedule is calendar 2024. Official signed approval is June 24, 2025; it does not change the salary year.
Financial Compensation is the remuneration column. Travel, Conferences and Other is the expense column. The separate Total includes expenses and is supporting evidence only.

Every original named employee row, including Jessica May's held row, is independently read and visually checked before publication selection. All seven accepted rows have exact pay-plus-expense agreement with their own source Total.

Eight named employees exist in the source; only seven are accepted. completeEmployeeSchedule and completeNamedCohort are false at both source and validation levels. Full-cohort source controls are not misrepresented as partial-cohort controls.

The source heading Staff does not state the exact disclosure-threshold equality boundary. thresholdComparison is null. Council 2024 is already accepted in municipal-wave-capital and is not duplicated.
